# `fintech_position_grain_unique`

> One position per account and day; duplicates would double-count balances.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **gold** — evaluated by the `gold` gate |
| Model | `gld_fintech__account_daily_positions` (`fintech_gold_staging.gld_fintech__account_daily_positions`) |
| Check | `unique_combination` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/gold/_gold.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/gold/_gold.yml) |

## What it checks

The combination of `account_id`, `position_date` is unique.

## When it fails

The `gold` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, `publish_gold` doesn't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_position_grain_unique`.

## Tested by

No sample-data scenario trips this rule yet: it guards against cases the generators don't produce.
